title: Make post-deploy checks tolerate Cloudflare rollout
acceptance: A single stale edge cannot fail the production job.
A wrong catalog or a replaced release still fails the job.

evidence.note: Catalog and final marker checks retry within a bounded window; both loops and both failure paths checked against production.
The #377 production job that failed on the race while production was correct.
Merged as #399; its own production job passed the new checks and production served this release marker.

summary: Production jobs for #396 and #377 were marked failed while production was correct.

activity.summary: Recorded from repository and CI evidence after integration.
